source_scope: E worktree, source hashes below. Native deployment and actual-model selection probe are separate root-managed steps.

confirmed_defect.trigger: Preview the third of three different shown DEMO plans while TripState stays.hotel_id remain null, then build extraction context for an edit preserving the first hotel.
confirmed_defect.before: The active quote durably contained plan3, but extraction exposed shown_plans and historical first_shown_plan only; no code-owned current selection identified plan3.
confirmed_defect.initial_control: Store quote=plan3 and unpinned TripState were correct; the missing-context assertion failed.

implementation.root_loader: Harness._selection_reference uses getattr/callable; fake stores without the method yield None.

sql_boundary.snapshot: One SELECT joins the owned session with its latest quote using a correlated session-filtered subquery, ordered by created_at/quote_version DESC and LIMIT1.
sql_boundary.latest_before_filter: Select the latest row before checking status/version/expiry. A later revoked row never reveals an older active row.
none_barriers: Quote or plan belongs to another trip/session
Future, stale or non-integer plan/binding version
Unknown stay, conflicting hotel identity or different stay city/dates
Missing hotel coverage for an owned stay

new_store_projection_cases.scope: Third-preview visibility, unchanged TripState/quote, stale/foreign/malformed guards, latest-revoked barrier, per-session isolation and MIXED bindings.

new_readonly_selection_cases.scope: Explicit ordinal/negative/ambiguous references retain shown positions. Selected plan3 feeds facts and hotel names without extra searches/orders or quote/trip changes.

root_initial_fixture_failure_preserved.cause: The nine-person sample provided only two DEMO plans. Root changed only fixture setup to the one-adult, three-plan trip; the plan3 requirement was retained.

verification.test_setup: Own sessions in isolated otravel_test; typed local DEMO search and preview establish data. Context/selection reads do not start another search or create an order.

readonly_answering_boundary.selection_source: Code-owned UI preview identity, not historical first displayed card.
readonly_answering_boundary.prices_source: Numbers may come from the saved shown-plan inventory only; identity projection contains no prices.

remaining: Actual model dialog: preview plan3, then replace only the second hotel and preserve the first.
Separate Native deployment/probe of the frozen release.
This change supplies current selection context; it does not promise universal reference resolution or persist a hotel preference automatically.

final_root_integration.checkout_scope: Suggested preview references selected plan3, no quote/order/consent created by chat
